requirement.evidence: (a) Notwithstanding any other law, after a tenant has continuously and lawfully occupied a residential real property for 12 months, the owner of the residential real property shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in the written notice to terminate tenancy.
requirement.note: Also covers the 24-month alternative and the cure notice requirement in subdivision (c).

key_value.note: 12 months, with 24-month rule when adult tenants are added.

coverage.evidence: (7) Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome.
coverage.note: The 15-year certificate-of-occupancy exemption is supported. The owner-occupied exemption is 'no more than two units or bedrooms' in a single-family residence, and the duplex exemption is also present. A single max-units value of 2 simplifies these.

requirement.evidence: The amount of relocation assistance or rent waiver shall be equal to one month of the tenant’s rent that was in effect when the owner issued the notice to terminate the tenancy. Any relocation assistance shall be provided within 15 calendar days of service of the notice.
requirement.note: The notice requirement and void-notice rule are in (d)(2) and (d)(4). The no-fault causes are listed in (b)(2).
